spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Morag Lindqvist. I transferred £2,450 to someone who said they were from your fraud team, and now I’m being passed around. I’m really unhappy with how the bank’s dealt with it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has happened, Morag, and that you’ve had to chase us. Before I look at anything on your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And could you confirm the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’ll take ownership of this from here. When did you make the transfer?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: On 18 October. They called saying my account was at risk and told me to move the money to a safe account.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you were put under that pressure. I can see why you’re upset with us. I’m logging this as a complaint about the way this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I want to know whether I’ll get the money back, and why nobody’s called me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise an outcome, but I’ll make sure the complaint includes both the transfer and the lack of contact. We’ll review what happened and the information you’ve already provided.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the complaint to our complaints team today, and I’ll call you by 4 pm tomorrow to confirm it’s been passed on and tell you the next steps. You’ll hear back from us within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I’ll wait for your call tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Morag. I’m sorry again for the experience, and I’ll make that call by 4 pm tomorrow.
